question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Did you guess what the contents of the letter were?
Do you want Howard and $ZOE to stay together?

labels: Push her out of the way!
Run as fast as you can!
Run as fast as she can!

nodes.text: Howard and $ZOE shoot down the waterslide at breakneck speed!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whooo!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wheeeheeeheee!
After a series of turns, they splash down into a churning pool! A moment later, they surface.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh man! We were going so fast! What a rush! That was awesome, wasn't it, $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah. It was!
As they walk out of the pool, though, $ZOE's smile fades...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's the problem, Howard... I always have so much fun with you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Having fun is the problem?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Look, thanks for trying to cheer me up...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It is? Because, guys... I think Dinah's going to break up with me.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Brendan, Dinah's not going to break up with you. You guys are just working through an issue, like me and $ZOE. Tell him, Hector...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Actually, Brendan, I'm not so sure about you and Dinah...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You aren't?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, she did ditch you at Prom, man.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: She had a good reason.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Which was?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I don't know yet, but there was one.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But wait... What do you `really` feel about me and $ZOE?
nodes.text_bbcode: But wait... What do you [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] feel about me and $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I think you two are fine. You're just going through a rough patch... I mean, she's not talking to you, she's hiding things, she won't meet your eyes...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hmmm, actually, that doesn't sound good at all.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I don't know what to think anymore, man. If the water park didn't work...
Hector starts the van back up and drives them toward the beach...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess since the water park didn't cheer $ZOE up, I know one thing for sure...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What's that?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is serious...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We're not breaking up!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That's the attitude you gotta have, man!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She seems really sad...
Hector leans over and slaps Howard across the face!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Don't do that!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Seriously, man, you can't even allow for that possibility to enter your head!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Once that happens, it's break-up city.
Howard and $ZOE stall halfway down the waterslide!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Our bodies are creating too much friction!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do we do?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We have to scoot along until there isn't any more friction, otherwise...
From above, they hear the echo of distant yell, then a booming thud...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Scoot, $ZOE, scoot!
Howard and $ZOE scoot as fast as they can... Suddenly, Spencer shoots around the corner!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Wheeeheeehee!...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: ...AHHHHHHH!!!`
Spencer collides with Howard and $ZOE and the three tumble down the rest of the waterslide, crashing into the frothing water at the bottom!
All three surface.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Not cool! You're supposed to slide, dummy! It's in the `name!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Not cool! You're supposed to slide, dummy! It's in the [color=#e23b3b][i]name![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry...
Howard sees $ZOE climbing out of the pool with a slight limp...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, wait!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Now, I know that you want to be alone...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I think it might help cheer you up if we go on one of the waterslides together.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What do you say?
$ZOE nods.
After a wet hike up some stairs, Howard and $ZOE are sitting on a mat together at the mouth of the tallest waterslide.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't think I want to do this! It's dark in there!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Trust me, $ZOE. It'll be fun!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I don't know what I'm doing!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'll help you. Look, the faster we go, the more fun it is!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All we have to remember are three things: relax, cross our arms over our chests, and cross our legs at the ankles!`

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ready?
$ZOE nods, and Howard pushes them off, and they shoot into the darkness of the covered slide!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I have to know... What did the letter say?
$ZOE cries, her shoulders heaving.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Howard... I can't tell you!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why not? Don't you think I have a right to know?
$ZOE sobs even harder!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sniffle...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm sorry... I shouldn't have pried...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just want to be alone, okay?
Howard pulls himself up onto $ZOE's innertube and puts his arm around her. She leans her head on his shoulder, and they float together...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't know what this problem is, $ZOE, but I know that whatever it is, in the end, everything will be okay.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How can you say that, when you don't know what it is?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Because I know that there isn't anything we can't handle together...
Tears suddenly start falling down $ZOE's cheeks...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Have you ever wanted something not to happen, but no matter how hard you tried...?
$ZOE turns her face away from Howard...
Howard splashes $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ack!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Surprise!
Howard splashes $ZOE again!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ack! Howard! Stop!
Howard stops...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't want to play right now...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You don't want to be splashed... At the water park?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm just not in the mood, that's all...
Howard wraps his arms around $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey! Who do you think...?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Surprise!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Howard! I didn't know it was you!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm glad you aren't accepting hugs from just anyone...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I wish I could `always` be with you like this...
nodes.text_bbcode: I wish I could [color=#3b78e2][i]always[/i][/color] be with you like this...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If you want to know what it said, I think you're going to have to find out from $ZOE... She's probably tanning with the rest of the cheerleaders in the lounge area.
Hector returns...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Dude, the girls aren't here! We came for no reason!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Relax. They're here... They're in the lounge area...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sweet! Come on!
As Howard and Hector approach the lounge area, they find the cheerleaders grabbing sun chairs from the Auto-Shop regulars...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Hey, those chairs are ours!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, find other chairs because these are the best chairs for tanning on... Not that `you` would know...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, find other chairs because these are the best chairs for tanning on... Not that [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] would know...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, FYI... Motor oil isn't sunscreen!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Grr...
Megan steps toward the cheerleaders, but Kenji holds her back!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Come on, Megan. You don't want to get kicked out of the water park! We can find other chairs...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: This isn't over!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Whatever...
While the cheerleaders are distracted, Hector sneaks up and gives Amanda a surprise hug!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, Manda-Panda!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Squee! Hector!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Howard! Look to us! We are soon to tan our hides like walruses beneath the arctic sun!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Stop comparing us to large sea creatures!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: She loves me!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Also, Howard, might I mention your barren chest is a landscape I want to prance upon.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: It makes myself both hot and bothersome.
Hector whispers to Howard...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: All right, Astrid called `herself` bothersome. That `has` to be irony.
nodes.text_bbcode: All right, Astrid called [color=#e23b3b][i]herself[/i][/color] bothersome. That [color=#e23b3b][i]has[/i][/color] to be irony.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Right. Hey, girls, have you seen $ZOE anywhere?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: She's probably filling up the Endless River with her tears... I don't care `what` you did, Howard, but you `have` to apologize!
nodes.text_bbcode: She's probably filling up the Endless River with her tears... I don't care [color=#3b78e2][i]what[/i][/color] you did, Howard, but you [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] to apologize!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's summer! It's the time for sales at the mall, no school, and hot guys! It's not the time for `any` of `my` cheerleaders to be crying!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's summer! It's the time for sales at the mall, no school, and hot guys! It's not the time for [color=#3b78e2][i]any[/i][/color] of [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] cheerleaders to be crying!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah! We cry enough `during` cheerleading! This is our time off!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah! We cry enough [color=#3b78e2][i]during[/i][/color] cheerleading! This is our time off!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Howard, if your American attachment is sad, maybe you will discard it for a better, foreign-made one?
Howard sees $ZOE floating by on an innertube on the Endless River...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... It was weird listening to you, Astrid, as always. I've gotta go...
Seeing an opportunity to surprise $ZOE, Howard sneaks up to the Endless River and slips into the water quietly... Then, he stealthily swims up behind her and...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yes, you do! You wrote the letter!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, I didn't!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You didn't?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What made you think I had?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Because ever since she got that letter she wanders around our house like a zombie saying, 'Oh, Howard! Oh, Howard!'

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I didn't write it. If I had written her the letter, I wouldn't have mailed it. I would have just handed it to her...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I didn't think of that... Now I feel bad. Here I was, planning to dye your hair green, and it turns out I've been scheming against the wrong person...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, I'm glad it's not you, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks... I think.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hmm... I wonder if $ZOE's told `anyone` about the letter...
nodes.text_bbcode: Hmm... I wonder if $ZOE's told [color=#e23b3b][i]anyone[/i][/color] about the letter...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Of course it does!
Sam leaps out of the pool and grabs Howard, pulling him in!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `AHHH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]AHHH![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Howard falls into the water. He sputters to the surface...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What did `I` have to do with this?
nodes.text_bbcode: What did [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] have to do with this?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't play dumb! Whatever you wrote in that letter really hurt my cousin!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I didn't write it!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?! You didn't?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why didn't you say that in the first place?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I was trying to figure out if you knew what it said!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Heh! Now you're talking! As soon as we meet up with the girls, $ZOE will be having a blast! Everyone has fun at Wacky!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm sure whatever is in that letter isn't going to be bumming her out when she's flying down a waterslide at a hundred miles an hour!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I hope you guys are right...
The guys pay for their tickets and stroll into Wacky Waterslides...
Waterslides corkscrew down into huge pools, the air is filled with the smell of barbecued meat, and people are splashing about everywhere, enjoying themselves...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Gentlemen, welcome to paradise.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is... More than nice.
Immediately, Dex and Ben run up to Brendan!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You brought your snorkel gear!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I assume you were the envy of your adventuring party...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You know it! I hope we discover a new species of aquatic moss!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Unlikely!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Come on!
The nerds scamper off.
Howard sees Erik standing at the edge of the kiddie pool, holding his stomach and groaning.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So many burritos...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You okay, Erik?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm in a real pickle, Howard! The water's perfect, but I'll get a cramp if I swim after eating! But if I don't eat, Ben and I will never beat Zach!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You know, the contest ended, right? I mean, $Scott declared you and Ben the winners when Zach tried to claim that a tortilla wrapped around a single bean still counted.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Everyone cheered for you guys, remember?
Erik blinks at Howard numbly for a moment...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh... Well, that did seem like a lot of fanfare for an intermission...
$Scott and Angie walk by hand-in-hand...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey, guys, you coming to my bonfire at the beach tonight? We're going to be burning all the stuff from school that we don't have to think about for the next three months! Old tests, papers, report cards, you name it!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Oh, and $Scott will be cooking hot dogs on the grill!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ooooog... Hot dogs...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We're there!
Howard sees Sam in a nearby pool, treading water with the swim team...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's so nice not to be fighting Taylor anymore for basic human freedoms.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I don't know how you ever put up with all that drama.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Seriously.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, where's Sara? Don't you think our MVP should be enjoying her time off?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: She's `practicing`... There's no time off when you're a Kessler...
nodes.text_bbcode: She's [color=#3b78e2][i]practicing[/i][/color]... There's no time off when you're a Kessler...

nodes.text: Hector gives Howard a nudge...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Maybe you can find out what $ZOE's letter said by asking Sam about it... They're practically sisters...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, good idea!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm going to see if I can find the girls...
Howard crouches down to the edge of the pool, and calls Sam over.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What do `you` want?
nodes.text_bbcode: What do [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] want?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... Is everything okay?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No! It isn't okay! $ZOE's crying every second of the day!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I haven't gotten `any` sleep! `I'm` miserable! `She's` miserable! And it's your fault!
nodes.text_bbcode: I haven't gotten [color=#3b78e2][i]any[/i][/color] sleep! [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] miserable! [color=#3b78e2][i]She's[/i][/color] miserable! And it's your fault!

nodes.prompt: What should you say to Sam?

options.label: It has nothing to do with me.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What should you say to Sam?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Granted, $ZOE's sad because of the letter, but what about `me?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Granted, $ZOE's sad because of the letter, but what about [color=#e23b3b][i]me?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Maybe I've got bad breath! Or I kiss like a fish! Or I'm being too selfish!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Maybe whatever's in this letter pointed out all my flaws!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Maybe it's a letter from an ex-boyfriend or something!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Maybe...
Hector leans over and slaps Howard across the face!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Been a long time since I had to do that... I'm not going to lie, it felt good.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's great, but what was that `for?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: That's great, but what was that [color=#e23b3b][i]for?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Your breath's fine, dude, and I've never heard any of the girls say you're a fish-kisser. Trust me, you're not the problem...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You think maybe I just haven't tried the right things?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That's gotta be it... No offense, bro, but watching a burrito-eating contest, playing pirates with your sisters, and juggling aren't exactly a day at the fair for most girls...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Or... A day at the water park?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: A burrito-eating contest, playing pirates with my sisters... These aren't exactly $ZOE's all-time favorite things to do...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm glad you said something, because no offense, bro, juggling for a girl isn't a play out of Casanova's book. Come to think of it, I don't think it's a play out of anyone's book...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Except for maybe clowns...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The point is... I bet $ZOE `will` have fun at the water park!
nodes.text_bbcode: The point is... I bet $ZOE [color=#e23b3b][i]will[/i][/color] have fun at the water park!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: One second we were ecstatic about graduation and the next she was... Well, sad.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ha! Both of you are sad. So ironic.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You never really listen to Ms. Prez, do you?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Nah. English class is like the elevator music of classes. When I pay attention to it, it just bugs me.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But that's not important... What about $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't know how to cheer her up...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ever since she got that letter, nothing seems to work...
Earlier that week, at $Scott's graduation party, Howard and $ZOE stand in a crowd around Zach, Ben, and Erik.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Burrito eating contest! One jock versus two nerds!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I eat these things for breakfast!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Whoa! That is not healthy at all, Zachary... Consider prunes or...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Erik, he's trying to psych us out!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh... Well, you should never fib about something as serious as nutrition!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Who do you think's going to win, $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know... $Scott, I guess...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But $Scott isn't even competing...
And the next day, in Howard's backyard...
Kay and Kel wield plastic swords and attack the treehouse!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yarr! Give us all yer treasure!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Or we'll make ye walk the plank!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh no... If only $ZOE the Parrotless could save me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...Yarrr...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Hey, what's wrong with $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Duh, she doesn't have her parrot!
And yesterday, in $ZOE's room...
Howard juggles three balls in the air...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Check it out! I'm doing three balls now, $ZOE. Want to see four?! Think I can't do it?! Well guess again cause I totally can!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's real nice, Howard...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wow... That got desperate.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know... I got up to five balls with a back flip, and she didn't even smile.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I juggled once for Amanda, and she started crying and told me never to practice witchcraft in front of her again.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What do you think the problem is?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I think...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Do you know what it said?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No... She won't tell me.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Do you know why she's sad?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's that letter she got...

nodes.title: Howard's Summer Bummer
nodes.subtitle: Can Howard handle the news about...?

nodes.text: The morning of the first day of summer...
Howard and Hector pull up to Brendan's house. The guys get out, walk up to Brendan's front porch, and ring the doorbell...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How are we doing on time? I want to make sure we get to Wacky Waterslides Water Park by eleven...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Relax...
Inside, Brendan is playing his favorite game, `The Sims Medieval...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Inside, Brendan is playing his favorite game, [b]The Sims Medieval...[/b]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'll be right down, guys!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hehehe! This game is the best!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yes, I `will` expand my empire of domination, thank you very much.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes, I [color=#e23b3b][i]will[/i][/color] expand my empire of domination, thank you very much.

nodes.text: Outside... Hector presses the doorbell again!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Where is he?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Probably playing a videogame...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Aww, no... He's probably playing that Sims Medieval game again. Amanda's been playing it non-stop ever since she found out that you can marry different characters!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Come on, Brendan!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I just hope we don't have to listen to nerd-talk the whole trip over...
Hector presses the doorbell and holds it in!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: All right, all right, I'm coming! Just let me put on my gear!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Gear? It's the water park... What is he putting on gear for?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Nerds wear gear.
The door swings open!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm ready to explore!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Gah! It's a mugger from the future!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Har-har... Just help me to the van, please.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We're going to the water park, Brendan, not the Pacific Ocean!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I know! Last summer, I found some fascinating mold growths in the water park's Endless River...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Man, I need new friends...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sorry I was late, guys. I just love the Sims! And there's talk of a `new Sims game` coming called `Sims Social!` I already clicked `Like it!` on the social networking site everyone uses!
nodes.text_bbcode: Sorry I was late, guys. I just love the Sims! And there's talk of a [color=#e23b3b][i]new Sims game[/i][/color] coming called [color=#e23b3b][i]Sims Social![/i][/color] I already clicked [color=#e23b3b][i]Like it![/i][/color] on the social networking site everyone uses!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So begins the nerd-talk...
The guys climb in to Hector's van, and they drive off...
Howard, Hector, and Brendan are on their way to Wacky Waterslides, Centerscore's water park...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are we going to get there on time? I told $ZOE we'd be there at eleven.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We're fine. Even the delay for scuba-nerd here isn't going to set us back...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey! You'll be jealous when I bring home some algal bloom specimens!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are you sure we're on time? I just really want to make sure $ZOE's not by herself for too long...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We're fine! Today is going to be perfect! Everyone from school's going to be there! It's a tradition!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh and by the way, Howard, `Relax!` It's `summer!` The school-free time of chicks in bikinis, sunny days, `and`...
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh and by the way, Howard, [color=#e23b3b][i]Relax![/i][/color] It's [color=#e23b3b][i]summer![/i][/color] The school-free time of chicks in bikinis, sunny days, [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: `Chicks in bikinis!` Do I have to say it again?!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Chicks in bikinis![/i][/color] Do I have to say it again?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Those are all nice.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Nice? `Nice?!` Sweaters are nice, man. Summer is `awesome!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Nice? [color=#e23b3b][i]Nice?![/i][/color] Sweaters are nice, man. Summer is [color=#e23b3b][i]awesome![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah... I guess so...
Hector slams on the brakes. The van fishtails, then screeches to a halt!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What's wrong?! Did we hit a duck?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That's it, I've had it! It's the first day of summer, and right now I'd rather go back to school and endure a Ms. Prez lecture on the real definition of irony than have to look at your sad face anymore!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You've been like this since graduation! What is going on with you, man?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, you've been weird.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's $ZOE. I'm just worried about...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Eh! A message isn't enough! There's gotta be something else I can do `now!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Eh! A message isn't enough! There's gotta be something else I can do [color=#e23b3b][i]now![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Howard resumes rummaging through $ZOE's other things...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Aha! She can't go to Europe without this!
Howard finds $ZOE's passport and stuffs it into his pocket!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And if she gets another one, and insists on going, I'll just figure out how to sneak into her luggage...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Kay and Kel can teach me! They sneak into my parents' luggage all the time!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: This isn't like you, Howard. Look at what you're doing...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, dude...
Suddenly, Sam charges into the room!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What are you doing?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What's it look like I'm doing?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It looks like you're destroying my cousin's room while she's alone and crying on a beach!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I found out what the letter said!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She told me.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So? She's going to France! She's ditching us!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Open your eyes, Howard! She doesn't `want` to go... She `has` to.
nodes.text_bbcode: Open your eyes, Howard! She doesn't [color=#3b78e2][i]want[/i][/color] to go... She [color=#3b78e2][i]has[/i][/color] to.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And right now she could really use someone caring and thoughtful like you to be there for her...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Whatever it is you're going to do, Howard, now's the time, man, because it feels really `really` weird for all of us to be in $ZOE's room without her.
nodes.text_bbcode: Whatever it is you're going to do, Howard, now's the time, man, because it feels really [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] weird for all of us to be in $ZOE's room without her.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She's very sick. But I'm taking good care of her. Don't worry too much! I'll keep you updated on how she's doing!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Just stay there in France... And, you know, don't send her any more letters... They just distress her!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Also, she sends her love... And stuff.
Howard hangs up.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Not bad!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's developed quite severely here in the States ever since one of the cheerleaders got a poodle.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And you know how France is just, um, `crawling` with French poodles. It has to be, right? Cause of the name!
nodes.text_bbcode: And you know how France is just, um, [color=#e23b3b][i]crawling[/i][/color] with French poodles. It has to be, right? Cause of the name!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Heh... Anyway, she can't come, so I wouldn't bother calling her and certainly I wouldn't send any more letters!
Howard hangs up.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How was that?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Honestly... Not very believable!
After some fast driving and quick turns, Howard pulls the van up to $ZOE's house... He gets out and marches to the front door...
Howard knocks on the front door...
Barking sounds come from the backyard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They put Puddles in the back when everyone's gone.
Howard lifts up the doormat, grabs the hidden key, and unlocks the door.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: This seems wrong, man.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yeah... It does.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Stay out here, then.
Howard barges into $ZOE's room and starts looking for the phone number for $ZOE's parents...
He tosses aside notebooks and stuffed animals and stacks of books!
Hector and Amanda stand in the doorframe...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Aha!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You found it?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm dialing $ZOE's parents now...
Howard reaches $ZOE's parents' voicemail... After a greeting and a few words in French, Howard hears a beep.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uhhhhh... Hi... This is Howard, $ZOE's boyfriend. Listen, $ZOE can't come to France because she...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm going to tell them something's happened to $ZOE that's preventing her from going!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Like what, man?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Like she's really sick, or she lost her passport or something...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I can't believe I'm saying this, but that might actually work. Are you sure you want it to?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I mean, I'm all for passionate gestures, but you're acting crazy...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm well-past crazy...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They'll have to listen to me! I mean, aren't they looking out for their daughter's best interest?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And isn't her best interest being with the guy she's in love with?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I hate to break it to you, man, but from what I know about parents, they don't tend to care about high school sweethearts...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Plus, they're in France... I mean, they want their daughter.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, Hector, do you have a better idea?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, I mean, if you're going to go down this path... I think you're going have to make up a lie.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I can't lie to $ZOE's parents, can I?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: If you want her to stay... Crazy as it is, I think you have to...
Tears start to well in $ZOE's eyes...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The letter is from my parents... From France.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They've found steady jobs there, and they love it, and they miss me, and they...
$ZOE makes no effort to wipe away her tears as they run down her cheeks.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They told me I have to come live with them in France... I have to.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `I'm going away.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm going away.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I can't believe it! When were you going to tell me?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What difference does it make, Howard?! There's nothing you can do about it!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's where you're wrong! I `can` do something about it!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's where you're wrong! I [color=#e23b3b][i]can[/i][/color] do something about it!

nodes.text: Howard marches off toward the parking lot...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Where are you going?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hector, give me your keys! We're leaving!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Come on, Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay! Road trip!
$ZOE calls to Howard as he leaves...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you going to do, Howard?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard? Howard?!
Howard takes Hector's keys and Hector and Amanda get in on the other side of the van... Howard drives off!
$ZOE stands for a moment, alone. Then she runs away from the bonfire, sobbing.
Sam goes to the parking lot and drives out, following Howard.
After a few moments of driving, Hector tries to break the tension...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So... Where are we going, buddy?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm a little concerned... I mean, your eyes are like crazy big right now, dude. I've never seen you this way...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Care to tell your best pal what the plan is?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm going to make it so that $ZOE doesn't go.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Where's $ZOE going?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: France.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I love France. Je m'appelle Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: $ZOE's moving to France?! Aww, man, not cool...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: How are you planning to stop her from going?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm going to find her parents' number and call them!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Whoa... That's a bold move, man. Are you going to lie about why she can't go?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Or are you going to tell them the truth about how much you love her?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm going to...

options.label: Tell them how much you love her!

nodes.text: Howard snatches the letter from $ZOE's hands!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you doing?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm going to read it! It's time for me to find out what's actually going on!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's personal! And you don't have to read it, okay?! I'll tell you what it says!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Don't burn the letter. Let me read it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You don't have to read it...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know you want to take it from my hands, but you're too sweet to...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll tell you what it says...
Howard stands there, silent.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't know... I saw you about to burn the letter, and...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And what, Howard?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And you wanted to take it from my hands?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Maybe...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I'll tell you what it says, okay?
A huge wall of water blasts out of the cannon!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: The water park followed us!
Neither Howard nor $ZOE can get away in time... Both of them can only turn their heads as the wall of water touches down on them and the rest of the cheerleaders with a tremendous `WOOSH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Neither Howard nor $ZOE can get away in time... Both of them can only turn their heads as the wall of water touches down on them and the rest of the cheerleaders with a tremendous [b]WOOSH![/b]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is the worst day ever!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Howard. You've always really cared about me...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But you shouldn't...
$ZOE plops down in the sand. Howard sits down next to her, silent.
Nearby, the cheerleaders assess the damage...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Uck!` I'm all wet!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Uck![/i][/color] I'm all wet!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Me too! So's my towel!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: No one cares about your tans when you look like a bunch of wet dogs! Ha!
Ryan pulls the car around, and Megan, Kenji, and the Auto-Shop crew run toward the car!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You'd better run! Don't think you'll get away with this!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Hey, wait... How come `you're` not soaked, Taylor?
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, wait... How come [color=#3b78e2][i]you're[/i][/color] not soaked, Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, and what's that wet nerd doing on the sand next to you?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh, see, I can clarify... I tripped right when the water-wall came, and I sort of covered Taylor... Accidentally, of course.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah... Don't let it happen again, Brendan!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I won't.
A little while later, tempers have calmed, and $Scott's gotten the bonfire going again. The students resume tossing stuff in...
Erik steps up to the fire...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't have anything cool or big to toss in... Just this can of hairspray I've been holding onto for sentimental reasons...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Erik! No! That's flammable!
But Erik has already tossed the can of hairspray in. It rests on the burning logs for a second, then explodes! A huge plume of fire rockets into the sky!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Nerd! That was the greatest thing I have ever seen!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: My eyebrows! Do I still have my eyebrows?!
Astrid takes her turn at the bonfire and drops in a wicker doll...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is it just me or do I look a lot like that doll she just tossed in?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Make the face ugly with your flames!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Probably just a coincidence...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Excuse me...
$ZOE gets up and stands in front of the bonfire...
She reaches into her pocket and pulls out a piece of paper.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `The letter!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]The letter![/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ZOE holds the letter out toward the fire...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `She's going to toss it in!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]She's going to toss it in![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Howard scrambles to his feet and runs to $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE! Wait!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Kenji, crank it to full! Ryan, get my car!
Ryan runs off toward the parking lot... Kenji adjusts a dial on the machine.
Howard covers $ZOE with his body! The ball of water slams down on top of Howard's back! $ZOE stays dry!
Howard shoves $ZOE! The ball of water slams into him, forcing him to the ground!
$ZOE falls hard!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ow! That hurt!
Howard stands there, frozen with panic! The ball of water slams into $ZOE, sending her to the ground!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now I'm soaked!
Cheerleaders scatter! Another ball of water heads toward them, this one aimed for $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `AHHH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]AHHH![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `$ZOE!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]$ZOE![/i][/color]

options.label: Push her out of the way!

nodes.text: Howard dodges out of the way! The ball of water splashes down on the sand!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Phew!
Howard throws the towel over himself! The ball of water crashes down on top of him, soaking him through!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Great... Now both me `and` my towel are sopping wet...
nodes.text_bbcode: Great... Now both me [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] my towel are sopping wet...

nodes.text: Howard panics and just stands there... The ball of water crashes down on top of him, soaking him through!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why didn't I do something?!
The guys arrive... A huge bonfire lights up the beach, and students are gathered around it, tossing in tests and homework papers!
Howard looks for $ZOE and sees her huddled with the other cheerleaders... He goes over and sits down beside her.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Hey.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Hey.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Look! Sam is going to throw something into the fire!
Sam steps up to the bonfire and throws in her pom-poms. She shoots Taylor a glare.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Pfft...
$Scott stands at the barbecue, grilling hot dogs.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: A cooler full of hot dogs and... Anj, how many people?
Angie does a cursory headcount...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: A lot.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Okay. Crunch some numbers... How many hot dogs per person?
Angie pretends to do some math in her head...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Carry the four... `And`... Also, a lot!
nodes.text_bbcode: Carry the four... [color=#3b78e2][i]And[/i][/color]... Also, a lot!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Everyone gets `a lot` of hot dogs! That's how we calculate in the summer!
nodes.text_bbcode: Everyone gets [color=#e23b3b][i]a lot[/i][/color] of hot dogs! That's how we calculate in the summer!

nodes.text: $Scott bends down and gives Angie a kiss!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: $Scott, man, this cookout is `genius!`
nodes.text_bbcode: $Scott, man, this cookout is [color=#e23b3b][i]genius![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: This is nothing... All just a warm up for Freedom Fest on the Fourth of July!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I can't wait!
Howard sees some of the Auto-Shop regulars down the beach hefting a large contraption! A huge tank of water sloshes behind it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, what do the Auto-Shop guys have over there? It looks like a gigantic...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `WATER CANNOOOOOOON!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]WATER CANNOOOOOOON![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Kenji and Ryan aim the cannon at the cheerleaders. Megan flips a switch on the water cannon, and a motor starts churning!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I told you... `This isn't over!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I told you... [color=#3b78e2][i]This isn't over![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Water shoots out of the cannon in thunderous bursts, each shot arcing across the beach toward Howard, $ZOE, and the cheerleaders!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `AHHHH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]AHHHH![/i][/color]

nodes.text: A ball of water heads right for Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I had a thought...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We don't have much time before you go away...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And the way I see it, we can either be sad about it, or we can really make the most of the time we've got left...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The 4th of July is coming soon... We can pack it full of memories!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hehehe! I like that thought...
Howard and $ZOE stand, and Howard holds her close for a moment...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I love you, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I love you, Howard.
Congratulations! You helped keep Howard from going off the deep end, `and` you managed to find a ray of sunshine buried in the sad cloud of $ZOE's impending departure...
nodes.text_bbcode: Congratulations! You helped keep Howard from going off the deep end, [b]and[/b] you managed to find a ray of sunshine buried in the sad cloud of $ZOE's impending departure...

nodes.text: In other words, you played a great game!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What happened to the lights?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Listen! Puddles has stopped barking... He only stops barking when...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `HE'S IN THE HOUSE!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]HE'S IN THE HOUSE![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Run! Run! Run!
The four scramble toward the front door of the house when Puddles suddenly slides across the floor, stopping right at the door! Everyone freezes!

nodes.speaker: Puddles
nodes.text: Grrr!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Puddles, it's me, Sam. Remember me. Easy, Puddles...

nodes.speaker: Puddles
nodes.text: Grrr!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What kind of ninja-dog `is` this? Is he going to bite us?!
nodes.text_bbcode: What kind of ninja-dog [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] this? Is he going to bite us?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Worse. He's a drooler!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay, then... What do we do?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I think we just have to wait until my mom comes home...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What?! Aren't you friends with him?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Not when he's in guard mode like this... He has no friends!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Don't be ridiculous!
Hector moves toward the door... In a flash, Puddles leaps at him!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Airborne dog!
Puddles tackles Hector to the ground, slobbering all over his face!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Too much! Acck! Ptthhbt! Get it off! Get it off!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector, is it fun?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Puddles! No! Bad dog!
Sam tries to rip Puddles off of Hector's face, but Puddles is too fast! In an instant, he's on top of her, licking her face!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, Puddles! `Ack!` Bad dog!
nodes.text_bbcode: No, Puddles! [color=#3b78e2][i]Ack![/i][/color] Bad dog!

nodes.text: Puddles leaps off of Sam's face and resumes his guard on the front door...
From Sam comes a string of obscenities... From Hector, a soft crying...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't know about you, Amanda, but I'm not moving.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yeah, I prefer my face to be slobber-free...

nodes.speaker: Puddles
nodes.text: Grrr!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We're doomed.
A half hour later, police lights flash outside! Officer Monte opens the front door.
Immediately, Puddles rolls over onto his back! Monte gives it a hearty rub!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I got a noise complaint from the neighbors! What are you fooligans doing here?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I broke, er, used a key to get in here to keep my girlfriend from going to France...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: And instead you're going straight to Boot Camp!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Officer, I don't think that's necessary. I live here, after all!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I decide what is and isn't necessary when it comes to the law around here! And entering a home unlawfully is grounds for Boot Camp!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: For who?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: For you! And this slick fella here!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Dude...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: And for red, too!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh... Are there tanning booths there?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is so unfair...
Howard in Boot Camp with Hector and Amanda?! That can't be the ending Howard wanted!
Try again and see if you can avoid a slobber-filled fate!
And if you have time, support Sims Social, the new game Brendan's been hearing so much about, and `Like it!` on Facebook!
nodes.text_bbcode: And if you have time, support Sims Social, the new game Brendan's been hearing so much about, and [b]Like it![/b] on Facebook!

nodes.text: Don't forget to join us on facebook.com/survivinghighschool to tell us what you thought of this episode and discuss SHS with other fans!

args.text: Try again! We know you can do it!

nodes.text: The four of them head toward the front door...
When $ZOE walks in!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard?! What are you doing in my house... And what were you doing in my room?!
$ZOE storms into her room! A cry of rage fills the house! She rushes up to Howard!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How could you?!

nodes.speaker: Howard

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Now that my betrothed's attachment is leaving the country to the land of France, I will use stealth and the wiles of my ancestors to lure him without his knowledge.

nodes.text: I will ensnare him the way American girls do by giggling at his word arrangements, as though my brain is made of tapioca and blubber!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I will bond with him... Me the sea otter, he the abalone shell.

nodes.text: And when the dust has made a settlement, I will be the one drowning in his eye beams and throwing coffee at his harpy suitors!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm going to miss you...

nodes.speaker: Zoe

Howard walks out of $ZOE's room.

nodes.text: Where are you going?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I've come to my senses now.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Good... And Howard...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Be gentle... She didn't have a choice on this one.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know...

Suddenly, he slams on the brakes. The van fishtails, then screeches to a halt!
A group of ducklings crosses in front of the van. When they've made it safely across, Howard drives on.
Howard returns to the beach. The fire has nearly gone out. People are packing up...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: When are you going?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Early July...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know.
